## Description

An amoeboflagellate (~20 µm) of soils and hot springs, with a limax form and eruptive pseudopods; it
eats bacteria, tolerates up to ~45 °C and encysts when it dries.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `hot_spring` (weight 4), `moss` (weight 1.5), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 6 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A small plastic-membrane amoeba that phagocytoses bacteria and forms [cysts](../../mechanics/life-cycle-and-division.md#cysts);
it can grow unchecked in a drop with abundant organic matter. Present in the hot-spring and moss biomes.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares the plastic membrane with the other amoebae; its small size needed the fine-remeshing fix for
[division of small plastic amoebae](../../mechanics/soft-bodies.md#plastic-membrane-amoebae).
